reproduction.runner:
set -eu
here=$PWD
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_REFERENCE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_SESSION_STORAGE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
for arm in stock owner; do (
 cd "$arm"
 c=crates/proteus-core
 path=$c/src/app_server/config_summary.rs
 cp "$path" "$here/$arm.settings.orig"
 cp "$c/src/lib.rs" "$here/$arm.lib.orig"
 cp "$here/meter.rs" "$c/src/w335_alloc.rs"
 printf '\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod w335_alloc;\n' >> "$c/src/lib.rs"
 cat "$here/$arm.probe.rs" >> "$path"
 cargo test --offline --locked --release -p proteus-core --lib --no-run -j 4 >"$here/$arm.build.log" 2>&1
 grep -F "($here/$arm/crates/proteus-core)" "$here/$arm.build.log"
 bin=$(sed -nE 's/.*Executable unittests src\/lib.rs \(([^)]+)\).*/\1/p' "$here/$arm.build.log")
 cp "$bin" "$here/$arm-tests"
 mv "$here/$arm.settings.orig" "$path"
 mv "$here/$arm.lib.orig" "$c/src/lib.rs"
 rm "$c/src/w335_alloc.rs"
 cd "$c"
mkdir -p "$here/$arm.wire"
 export W335_WITNESS_DIR="$here/$arm.wire"
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::config_summary::' --skip w312_no_such_test --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.test.log" 2>&1
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::session_model::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.model.log" 2>&1
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::http::tests::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.api.log" 2>&1
); done
reproduction.runner_environment: Supply the matching local inert reference and session-storage fixtures from the existing Core test setup to the runner. Both native binaries are standalone stock/candidate, not full-app releases.
